{{Description|The public auditorium in Startorch Academy that serves as the primary venue for large-scale indoor events. It is available to student activities. To host an event here, student societies or fan clubs must submit a proposal and application to the Student Council at least three working days in advance. Upon approval, the event will be officially registered and circulated.}}
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is is a [[Point of Interest]] located in [[Startorch Academy (Region)|Startorch Academy]]. You can invite companions to watch movies here after the completion of {{Quest|Gold Suspended in Shadows}}.

==Movies==

*{{color|help|(10:00)}} "Doomsday Divas" is the latest sensation of the genre. It follows a heroine who, after a twist of fate, is forced to hit the road on a desperate journey to the "edge of the world"...

*{{color|help|(12:00)}} "The Quadricentennial Man" is a sci-fi movie adapted from a novel by the same name. It follows the journey of Rupert, a machine that embarks on a journey to become "human" in the name of love.

*{{color|help|(14:00)}} "The Shadowed Identity" is an action movie about a man driven by revenge against evil forces, who plunges headfirst into the world of espionage... 

*{{color|help|(16:00)}} "Reborn Poets Society" is a poignant drama that follows an unconventional teacher whose radical methods rekindle a passion for life in his students...

*{{color|help|(18:00)}} "Winged Marathon" is a documentary co-produced by world-famous cinematographers. It chronicles the spectacular seasonal journey of migratory birds...

==Inviting Companions==
*Different movies appear at different times. 
*Specific characters can't be invited for certain movies as it does not suit them. 

{{Dialogue Start}}
:As you step into the cinema, the entire world seems to fall silent. In the dimly lit space, the hazy, flickering images on the projection screen hint at the upcoming movie...
:You scan the announcements on the Academy Forum and notice that a newly released movie is about to start...
:{{DIcon}} (Check out the latest road trip movie.)
::"Doomsday Divas" is the latest sensation of the genre. It follows a heroine who, after a twist of fate, is forced to hit the road on a desperate journey to the "edge of the world"...
:{{DIcon}} (Check out the latest sci-fi movie.)
::"The Quadricentennial Man" is a sci-fi movie adapted from a novel by the same name. It follows the journey of Rupert, a machine that embarks on a journey to become "human" in the name of love.
:{{DIcon}} (Check out the latest action movie.)
::"The Shadowed Identity" is an action movie about a man driven by revenge against evil forces, who plunges headfirst into the world of espionage... 
:{{DIcon}} (Check out the latest art movie.)
::"Reborn Poets Society" is a poignant drama that follows an unconventional teacher whose radical methods rekindle a passion for life in his students...
:{{DIcon}} (View details about the latest documentary.) 
::"Winged Marathon" is a documentary co-produced by world-famous cinematographers. It chronicles the spectacular seasonal journey of migratory birds...

:...Invite a friend to watch it with you?
----
:{{DIcon}} (Invite Lynae.)
::Judging from the summary, this seems like a movie Lynae would like... You invite her.
::'''You send an invitation to Lynae...'''
::'''Lynae:''' I'm here! I'm here!
::'''Lynae:''' Doomsday Divas! I've been waiting for it to come out for ages! Can't believe you remembered the kinda stuff I'm into!
::'''Lynae:''' C'mon, let's get inside!
::You and Lynae settle in for a movie night to remember..
::'''Lynae:''' Whoa, didn't see that ending coming...
::'''Lynae:''' Her whole trip was full of crazy stuff and she had her moment to shine... but she never made it to where she thought she was going. Kind of tragic, huh?
::{{DIcon}} Yes, a bit tragic.
:::'''Lynae:''' ...Right. But hey, she managed to do her big one. Can't say it was all in vain.
::{{DIcon}} No, her journey was still worth it.
:::'''Lynae:''' ...You're right. She managed to do her big one. Can't say it was all in vain!
::'''Lynae:''' Anyway, let's watch another movie together soon! I'm free whenever... Why are you looking at me like that? I'll pick a time when you don't have class, duh!
----
:{{DIcon}} (Invite Mornye.)
::Judging from the summary, this seems like a movie Mornye would like... You invite Mornye.
::You send an invitation to Mornye...
::'''Mornye:''' Sorry to keep you waiting, Mentor. It took me a while to shut down the experiment, but it looks like I arrived in time.
::'''Mornye:''' I don't really watch movies. You know I spend most of my time in the lab working on experiments...
::'''Mornye:''' But a sci-fi movie? I'll give it a try. Perhaps I'll even get some inspiration from it.
::'''You and Mornye settle in for a movie night to remember...'''
::'''Mornye:''' We still lack a rigorous definition for the emotion known as \"love.\" Not to mention an explanation of its origins or its operating principles.
::'''Mornye:''' As a mechanical entity... how could Rupert ever determine that he possessed such an emotion?
::'''Mornye:''' It's hard for me to understand, but after seeing Rupert and Susanna embrace, I do want to believe... that "love" is real.
::{{DIcon}} Love transcends all things.
::{{DIcon}} Love is hard to explain.
::'''Mornye:''' Yes... Science has yet to explain much of the phenomena in the world.
::'''Mornye:''' I've heard students talk about such things before—that all scientific explanations of mechanical things are actually reflections of the human condition... This movie truly was worthwhile.
::'''Mornye:''' I should analyze this movie frame by frame. Thank you... I hope we can watch another movie together sometime.
----
:{{DIcon}} (Invite Luuk Herssen.)
::Judging from the summary, this seems like a movie Luuk Herssen would like... You invite Luuk.
::You send an invitation to Luuk Herssen...
::'''Luuk Herssen:''' Your invitation to join you for a movie came as a surprise. A pleasant surprise, of course.
::'''Luuk Herssen:''' I'm not much of a movie buff, to be honest. Thanks to the Ichor, I see everything in shades of gray, no matter how vibrant it's supposed to look.
::'''Luuk Herssen:''' But I've heard about this movie from my students. They say the fight choreography is incredible. That, I can appreciate.
::'''Luuk Herssen:''' Shall we? It's about to start... Oh, and how about some popcorn?
::'''You and Luuk settle in for a movie night to remember...'''
::'''Luuk Herssen:''' t's true what they say. A little controlled dopamine release does wonders for one's state of mind.
::'''Luuk Herssen:''' You could feel every punch and kick right through the screen. I've needed that kind of adrenaline rush for a while.
::'''Luuk Herssen:''' And the espionage, the intrigue... The depiction felt authentic.
::{{DIcon}} Did it resonate with you? After all, you were undercover for a while...
::{{DIcon}} Did it feel familiar? After all, you know how to navigate a fight...
::'''Luuk Herssen:''' Haha! No, that's not it.
::'''Luuk Herssen:''' The period of my life "mingling" with their members wasn't that stressful.
::'''Luuk Herssen:''' Anyway, that was a great watch. Really. Let me know when you're in the mood for another. I've got plenty of leave saved up.
----
:{{DIcon}} (Invite Lucilla.)
::Judging from the summary, this seems like a movie Lucilla would like... You invite Lucilla.
::You send an invitation to Lucilla...
::'''Lucilla:''' Reborn Poets Society... A true classic! One of my favorites, actually. Seems like you know my tastes.
::'''Lucilla:''' The Academy lends out videotapes, but I've always wanted to rewatch it on the big screen.
::'''Lucilla:''' Thank you for the invite. You just saved me from missing the release under a mountain of paperwork.
::'''Lucilla:''' It's about to start. Ready to go in?
::'''You and Lucilla settle in for a movie night to remember...'''
::'''Lucilla:''' I pick up something new every time I watch it. Every time...
::'''Lucilla:''' Keaton cultivated something lasting in his students. And that final tribute they gave him at the end...
::'''Lucilla:''' ...I don't think there's an educator who wouldn't be moved by that.
::'''Lucilla:''' {{Rover}}, what kind of teacher do you prefer?
::{{DIcon}} The ones who are highly qualified.
::{{DIcon}} The ones who adapt to the student.
::{{DIcon}} The... less strict kind.
::'''Lucilla:''' Hm... Interesting. I'll remember that.
::'''Lucilla:''' The gravity of reality is so heavy. It can crush spirits meant to be light...
::'''Lucilla:''' I've always believed part of our duty is to guard the idealism in our students' wings, to be the wind that helps them soar.
::'''Lucilla:''' I have a long list of classics I'd love to revisit. Let's make this a habit. An invitation to unwind is one I'll always accept.
----
:{{DIcon}} (Invite Sigrika.)
::Judging from the summary, this seems like a movie Sigrika would like... You invite Sigrika.
::You send an invitation to Sigrika...
::'''Sigrika:''' Phew... I made it! I'm here!
::'''Sigrika:''' So you're interested in documentaries? That's surprising...
::'''Sigrika:''' Most of my friends think they're boring. They prefer "popcorn flicks" instead.
::'''Sigrika:''' This is the first time anyone's invited me to watch a documentary, so... Thanks! Should we, um, head in?
::'''You and Sigrika settle in for a movie night to remember...'''
::'''Sigrika:''' Birds go through so much. The danger, the predators, the storms... just to make it to their "Promised Land" and survive.
::'''Sigrika:''' People always say that documentaries don't have a storyline, but I think this one was about...
::{{DIcon}} It was a story about promises.
::{{DIcon}} It was a story about determination.
::'''Sigrika:''' Yes! Migration is just an instinct for them, but still. Life just refuses to give up, you know?
::'''Sigrika:''' And the photographers... imagine waiting days, weeks, just for one perfect moment. That's not just patience and respect. That's love.
::'''Sigrika:''' This was so wonderful... Thanks for thinking of me, Senior! I'd love to do this again sometime!
----
:{{DIcon|Exit}} I've got more important things to do...
{{Dialogue End}}
